messages:
maria: AM update — kicked off EU preheat for model-serving pool (eu-west-1 + eu-central). Autoscaler reached target but 2 nodes failed healthcheck, left 48 GPUs instead of 64. Ticketed INFRA-834.
liam: thanks — pinging @anika to check quota bump with cloud team. Did we hit the regional softlimit?
anika: already on it, opened cloud-ops ticket (cloud-ops#221). Cloud says eu-central softlimit is 60, need request for +2 GPUs. Filing request now, ETA 6-8h :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria: blocker — Dedicated tenant acme-inc needs reserved GPUs in eu-central today for rollout. If quota not approved we'll fallback to eu-west (cross-region routing) which adds ~20ms latency. Any concerns?
sam: I can own cross-region routing if we need it. Also there's a PR blocking rollout: infra/engine#421 — small kv-cache config tweak. @liam can you review?
liam: on it, quick pass in ~15m. Also devops-bot reported an error during preheat: `InstanceStateError: failed healthcheck: nv_peer_mem missing` — can someone check kernel module on nodes?
anika: saw that — same kernel drift we hit last week. eu-central image is older. Kicking AMI bake: baker/2026-03-18-ami-eu.json and will trigger rolling replace after quota resolved.
maria: noted. Handoff plan: @sam owns routing + rollback, @anika owns AMI bake and quota ticket, I'll monitor acme-inc tenant and update product.
devops-bot: Preheat run started 1741239876, target=64 GPUs, current=48. Alerts enabled.
liam: quick addition — add a smoke check to preheat script: `curl -sS https://staging-api.redwood.ai/health | jq .gpu_pools` — if result >0 proceed. I'll add it to infra/ops-scripts.
sam: ack. Queuing cross-region rule: `route add-policy tenant=acme region=eu-central fallback=eu-west priority=5`
maria: thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll post updates here when cloud replies or AMI bake finishes.
